page_title: ESP 2-1 SEV | Espanyol v Sevilla 24/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+7' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) smashes the ball from the mid-range free-kick straight into the defensive wall.
90+7' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) sees a yellow card from Miguel Sesma after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
90+7' Miguel Sesma interrupts the game. One of the players from Espanyol won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Sevilla are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
90+4' Castrin (Sevilla) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

90+3' Akor Adams (Sevilla) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) coming on for Tyrhys Dolan.
86' 2 - 1 Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) scores an own goal inside his own left post as he attempts to head the ball away from the corner kick.
86' It will be a corner kick for Sevilla.
85' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
84' 2 - 0 Goal! Urko Gonzalez tees up Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the top right corner. 2:0.
84' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing. The ball is out of play. Espanyol win a corner kick.

83' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jofre (Espanyol), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

82' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
78' Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

76' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
75' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:4.
74' The referee signals a substitution. Charles Pickel (Espanyol) is brought on as a substitute for Pere Milla.
74' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jofre (Espanyol) for Kike Garcia.
71' Matias Almeyda has decided to make a change. Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) replaces Peque.
71' A substitution has been made. Batista Mendy is replaced by Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) replaces Djibril Sow.
71' Miguel Sesma rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Pere Milla (Espanyol).
69' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
68' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is penalised for holding. Miguel Sesma signals a set piece. Sevilla earn a free kick.
67' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Espanyol have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
64' Sevilla failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Ramon Terrats is replaced by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol).
62' Substitution. Pol Lozano (Espanyol) replaces Exposito.
59' Pere Milla (Espanyol) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

57' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
56' Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
54' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Alfonso Gonzalez comes onto the pitch to replace him.
53' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
50' Miguel Sesma shows a yellow card to Exposito (Espanyol), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.

48' 1 - 0 Goal! Tyrhys Dolan hands Pere Milla (Espanyol) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the top left corner. 1:0.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' The corner is swung in but Sevilla can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+2' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
42' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Sesma had a clear view and blows his whistle. A free kick to Sevilla.
39' Peque (Sevilla) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Marko Dmitrovic has no trouble gathering it.

38' Akor Adams (Sevilla) takes the ball, nicely zig-zags through the defence, but his shot to the left post is smartly dealt with by Marko Dmitrovic. Sevilla force a corner. They send men into the box.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.

36' CHANCE! Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic produces an excellent save. Sevilla will take a corner kick.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 33:67.
34' Matias Almeyda is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) suffers an injury and Chidera Ejuke comes on.
32' Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
31' PENALTY APPEAL after Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
30' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' The resulting corner from Peque (Sevilla) is cleared by the opposition's defence. The ball is out of play and Sevilla manage to earn a corner.

29' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Akor Adams (Sevilla), but Marko Dmitrovic is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass. The ball is out of play. Sevilla will have a chance to score from a corner.
25' The game is interrupted now, Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
23' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
23' An attempted cross from Akor Adams (Sevilla) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Sevilla can continue in their attacking effort.
21' Peque (Sevilla) takes the corner but it's cleared.
20' The corner from Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) is intercepted by Marko Dmitrovic. Sevilla have a corner.
18' Peque (Sevilla) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the right post. Aim better, sir.
17' The resulting set piece from Sevilla is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
17' Akor Adams (Sevilla) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save. The referee signals a corner kick to Sevilla.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
14' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Good work from Espanyol as they win a corner.
13' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
8' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
7' Pere Milla (Espanyol) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
4' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.
2' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Sevilla will take the kick-off.
Miguel Sesma will supervise the game today.
